note: Phase 8B (0D PL-54, ADR-0047): the only tools an agent profile can be granted. Each is a registered, versioned operation of the product bound to one accepted 0C agent tool class. Granting a tool never grants record access: 8C runs a tool only within the run scope (profile grants, the assigner's access, and the assignment scope) and the class's approval requirement for that instance. Unavailable tools name the phase that ships their operation; they can be drafted, never activated.

tools.name: pm.tasks.list
tools.description: List tasks inside the run scope.

tools.name: pm.tasks.get
tools.description: Read one task inside the run scope.

tools.name: pm.documents.get
tools.description: Read one document inside the run scope.

tools.name: pm.documents.draft
tools.description: Create a document in the draft state inside the run scope.

tools.name: pm.tasks.create_subtask
tools.description: Create a subtask under the run's own task.

tools.name: pm.deliverables.draft_version
tools.description: Attach an artifact as a draft deliverable version of the run's task (a human accepts it).

tools.name: pm.tasks.update
tools.description: Update fields of a task inside the run scope (never its completion or acceptance).

tools.name: pm.tests.run
tools.description: Trigger a test run in a non-production environment (test management arrives in 9B).

tools.name: github.pull_requests.open
tools.description: Open a pull request in a mapped repository (the GitHub integration arrives in 9A).
